headline: No Female Daily refresh for SAFF, HMNS, Mykonos or Onix today; last read SAFF 4.32 vs Mykonos 4.29. POSTOJNA, SAFF's first fruity-fresh scent (Rp350,000), is missing from some retail catalogues.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily vs 20 Nov: Mykonos 4.27→4.29 (+0.02; +0.03 over 7 days), HMNS 4.18→4.15 (−0.03), SAFF 4.32, Alchemist 4.43 and Onix 4.17 flat. SAFF's gap over Mykonos is now 0.03.

HMNS Drops of Sunshine fell 4.7→4.3 and Philea 4.6→4.2 (each one review fewer); Mykonos Baby Love flipped back up 4.2→4.6 (83 reviews) and Moroccan Vanilla 4.4→4.2. SAFF Las Pozas lost one review (91) at 4.6.
SAFF official-store ratings stay very high: Irai Leima 4.9 from 5,124 Tokopedia ratings (about 0.5% at 1–2 stars) and Las Pozas 4.9 from 1,424 Zalora reviews.
Cascavel (4.9 from 1,992 ratings) shows as sold out on SAFF's official Tokopedia store — a lost-sale and reseller risk.
POSTOJNA launched mid-2026 at Rp350,000 and is framed as SAFF's first fruity-fresh scent, but the Scentica catalogue still lists 17 older SAFF scents without it.

recommendations.text: Restock Cascavel on the official Tokopedia store, or add a back-in-stock notice, so buyers do not move to unofficial sellers.
Use product-level proof such as Irai Leima 4.9 from 5,124 Tokopedia ratings in ads and product pages, not store-wide scores.
Report unverified SAFF resellers and decant shops, and publish an authorised-reseller list plus a 'how to spot a fake' guide.
For S.O.T.B, add 'how much to spray' and 'best for evening / cool rooms' guidance in copy to answer 'too strong' and 'common' complaints.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
